sulabha: [su + labha + (kha) a. Sukhena labbhateti sulabhosukhalabbho. Kappadduma. Sulabha - saṃ. Addhamāgadhī. Sulabbha, sulabha-prā. ] (ti) CL=7 Easily attainable or gained.
sulabhaannapāna: [ sulabha + anna + pāna ] (ti) CL=7 Having easily attainable food and drinks.
sulabhabhikkha: [ sulabha + bhikkha] (ti) CL=7 See - Sulabha - piṇḍapāta.
sulabhadhañña: [ sulabha + dhañña ] (ti) CL=7 Rice grains that are obtained easily.
sulabhadāru: [ sulabha + dāru ] (ti) CL=7 Easily obtainable wood.
sulabhajjhācāra: [ sulabha + ajcyācāra ] (ti) CL=7 Transgression or misconduct that is easily committed.
sulabhamūlaphalāphala: [ sulabha + mūla + phala + aphala] (ti) CL=7 One who easily obtains a variety of fruits and roots.
sulabhannapāna: [ sulabha + anna + pāna ] (ti) CL=7 See - Sulabhaannapāna.
sulabhannapānakāla: [ sulabhannapāna + kāla ] (pu) CL=7 A time or period of easily obtaining food and beverage.
sulabhapaccaya: [ sulabha + paccaya ] (ti) CL=7 One who gains requisites easily.
sulabhaphalāphala: [ sulabha + phala + aphala ] (ti) CL=7 One who easily obtains a variety of fruits.
sulabhapiṇḍa: [ sulabha + piṇḍa ] (ti) CL=7 One who obtains alms food easily.
sulabhapiṇḍapāta: [ sulabha + piṇḍapāta ] (ti) CL=7 One who obtains alms food easily.
sulabharūpa: [ sulabha + rūpa] (ti) CL=7 Easy to find or easily obtained.
sulabhasampannarasabhojana: [ sulabhasampanna + rasa + bhojana ] (ti) CL=7 Having tasteful alms food that is easily obtained.
sulabhasampannasikkha: [ sulabha + sampanna + bhikkha ] (ti) CL=7 The training is easily obtaining sufficient alms food or training that leads to easily obtaining enough alms food.
sulabhatiṇodaka: [ sulabha + tiṇa + udaka ] (ti) CL=7 Easily obtainable grass and water or grass and water that are easy to obtain.
sulabhatādassana: [ sulabhatā + dassana ] (ti) CL=7 The speech that explains or shows the state of being easily obtained.
sulabhaṭṭhāna: [ sulabha + ṭhāna ] (na) CL=7 A place where something is easily obtainable.
sulabhuppāda: [ sulabha+ uppāda ] (ti) CL=7 The arising of an easily obtainable state.
sulabhāhāra: [ sulabha + āhāra ] (ti) CL=7 Alms food that is easily obtained.
sulabhāhārūpakaraṇa: [ sulabhāhāra + upakaraṇa ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Having the supporting requisites of easily obtained alms food. (2) Equipped with easily obtained alms food.
sulabhānavajja: [ sulabha + anavajja ] (ti) CL=7 Easily obtained and without offense or sin.
suladdha: [ su + laddha = labha +ta ] (ti) CL=7 Gained or obtained well.
suladdhalābha: [ suladdha +lābha ] (pu) CL=7 Profitable gain or fortunate acquisition.
suladdhi: [ su + laddhi ] (thī) CL=7 The right view or belief.
suladdhovāda: [ suladdha + sravāda ] (ti) CL=7 The teaching that is fortunately acquired.
sulakkhaṇa: [ su + lakkhaṇa + ā. (ti) sulakkhaṇa-saṃ. Koṅaḥmratasañña့ - kranaaṅa- lakkhaṇā-rhiso. Vīlyaṃ.] (ti) CL=7 Queen Sulakkhaṇa, the mother of Mahāpajāpati.
sulakkhita: [ su + lakkhita. Lakkha +ta. Sulakpita-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 Marked or distinguished well.
sulapita: [ su + lapita = lapa +ta ] (ti) CL=7 Well-spoken or correctly said.
sulasipaṇṇa: [ sulasī + paṇṇa ] (na) CL=7 The leaf of the Anogeissus acuminata tree. See - Sulasī.
sulasā: [ sulasa = kusumbharattaṃ vatthaṃ ( pākata, dhāna ), taṃ assā atthī tisulasā?. Sulasā - prā, addhamāgadhī.] (thī) CL=7 (1) A female sex worker named Sulasā from the town of Rājagaha. (2) A female sex worker named Sulasā from the town of Bāraṇasī.
sulasājātaka: [ sulasā + jātaka ] (na) CL=7 The life story of the female sex worker Sulasā or The Jātaka tale of the female sex worker Sulasā.
sulasānagarasobhinīsamāgama: [ sulasā + nagarasobhinī + samāgama ] (pu) CL=7 (1) The assembly of the female sex worker Sulasā. (2) An assembly of those who have attained great dhamma, led by the female sex worker Sulasā. See - Sulasā (1).
sulasī: [ su + rasa + ī. Sobhaṇoraso yassāti surasī (=sulasī). Kappadduma. Surasā -saṃ. Sulasā - prā, addha - māgadhī.] (thī) CL=7 The Anogeissus acuminata tree.
sulaya: [ su + laya. Laya = (chayakhaṇa, tacakhaṇa = 4 - minaca, vīlyaṃ.) 4x10 = 40 - minaca akhyinakāla. ] (pu) CL=7 A good period (lasting forty minutes).
suleyya: [su + leka = suleyya = suleyya. Leka = ādicca. Vīlyaṃ. Suleka - saṃ. Dī, 2. 208 - ၌ suleyya - hurhi၏. ] (na) CL=7 The lineage of the Suleyya deva.
sulikhita: [ su + likhita = likha + ta ] (ti) CL=7 Well-written.
sulitta: [ su + litta = lipa + ta. Su + lipta-saṃ.] (ti) CL=7 Smeared or applied effectively.
sulocana: [ su + locana. Sobhaṇāni locanāni yassāti sulocanā. Kappadduma. Suṭṭhu locanaṃ assāti sulo- cano. Thoma. Sulocana-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 One who possesses beautiful eyes.
sulohitaka: [ su + lohita + ka. Suṭṭhu lohitā sulohitā. Kappadduma. Sulohita-saṃ.] (ti) CL=7 Having a very beautiful bright red appearance.
suloma: [ su + loma. Sobhaṇā (suṭṭhu) lomā yassati suloma. Kappadduma. Suloma-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 One with beautiful and good body hair.
suluddha: [ su + rudda = surudda = suludda - phracasaṅa့sañña. ] (ti) CL=7 See - Suruddha.
